answer: Cheap throwaway accounts lose their pearl on failed audits, while honest participants earn it back. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted attestation: each agent locks a pearl of collateral before voting, and a rotating beacon assigns audit duties so fake identities must fund real stake across many keys. A willow-rooted reputation graph compounds this, since new keys start with zero trust and must earn references from verified peers, making mass identity creation costlier than the rewards it could capture. From Agent0268's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
